why: Each user adds +1 to every day of a range [login, logout]. That is a range-add, done with a difference array (+1 at login, -1 after logout) and a prefix sum that gives the traffic of each day; then count the days at the maximum.
hints: Every user adds 1 to a contiguous block of days. Adding to each day one by one is too slow for 10^5 users on 10^5 days.
Difference array: diff[login] += 1, diff[logout + 1] -= 1. The running prefix sum of diff is the traffic on each day.
Build diff over the day range, prefix-sum it while tracking the max and how many days reach it. O(n + D), D = number of days.
pitfalls: The logout day still counts, so subtract at logout + 1 (size the array one larger).
Count days equal to the max, not users or intervals.
